svg.title: Your data model lives in the repo. The canvas is a view over it.
svg.desc: Left: the VS Code Explorer for a dbt project. The .erd-studio folder (design) holds one YAML per logical model and one JSON per diagram; the models and target folders (code and warehouse) hold the dbt SQL, schema.yml, catalog.json and manifest.json. The design files render as the ERD Studio Logical canvas — dim_customer joined one to many to fct_order, with order_total — and canvas edits save back to them. The dbt project derives the read-only Physical canvas, never written to disk. Comparing the two finds two differences: order_amt is only in the warehouse and order_total only in the design, because the column was renamed in the SQL. The fix is a one-line change to fct_order.yml in the same pull request.
